title: Bake & Mystery Challenge

blocks.title: Safety first
blocks.text: Check your school’s food requirements and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each ingredient label, including any Mystery ingredient. Only adults handle the oven and hot pans.

items: Book the oven and an adult for the whole session; check how many pans fit at once
Confirm whether students may eat what they bake, and when; cupcakes won’t be cool by the end of the session
Shop from the recipe card: one recipe per team makes about 12–18 standard cupcakes
Give each team its own labelled cupcake pan with liners, bowl, square pan, measuring cups and spoons, and fork
Hand-washing and cleaning supplies, oven mitts, and a safe spot for hot pans

items.text: Halfway through mixing, every student takes a new role.
Remove one mixing tool; never oven mitts or safety equipment.
Only after the allergy check above; set out one portion per team.
Only if teams decorate in a later session, once the cupcakes are cool.

items.title: Roles
items.text: Teams pick roles: Leader, Reader, Ingredient Manager, Mixer, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew. Everyone washes hands.

items.title: Measure and mix
items.text: Mystery: reveal the twist. Teams follow the recipe and fill liners about ¾ full.

items.title: Bake
items.text: An adult bakes each load for 20–25 min and checks with a toothpick.
Switch the oven to 350°F (175°C) at the start; it takes 10–15 min to heat.
Each extra load adds 20–25 min. Teams wait and wash up at their station, not at the oven.
